title: Photo and words
description: Half the slide is the user's photo or clip, revealed by a clean wipe from the edge; the other half carries the heading and two or three points on hairlines. The most useful business slide.

props.src: required, a photo or an mp4 of the user's own
props.title: required, heading, 1-8 words
props.items: 2-4 short points ("Title: one line" or {title, text})
props.side: left or right: where the picture goes (default left; with a face, the words stay off it)
props.face: [x, y, w, h] of a face, 0 to 1
props.body: [x, y, w, h] of the person

example.alt: A carrot cake on a wooden table
example.title: Made in small batches
